checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: zero-dependency 4x4 tile-merge game with a themed browser UI under the AIKit UI contract

impact_assessment.why: the user asked for a game project with a UI suited to AIKit; a pure-Python engine plus static web surface proves cleanly without third-party dependencies
impact_assessment.benefits: a playable local game, a worked example of a Python-backed UI contract with inventory and theme-token proofs, and gates that run in under a few seconds
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the UI surface, protected paths and snapshot command must match the real tree; dependency: standard library only, no npm or browser test runner; concurrency: one in-memory game guarded by a lock, no cross-client sessions; state: the board is session-only, so a server restart starts a new game
impact_assessment.mitigation: write the UI contract from the finished tree, keep engine rules pure and unit-tested, serialize every game mutation behind a lock, and document the no-persistence boundary in the README
